G0.prompt: To convert camelCase to snake_case, lowercase the whole string and insert an underscore before every uppercase letter except a leading one. Convert "camelToSnake" to snake_case. Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.

Normalizing whitespace collapses every run of spaces into one single space and removes leading and trailing spaces. Normalize the whitespace in this string: "a   b  c" (three spaces after a, two after b). Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.

Run-length encoding replaces every run of identical characters with that character followed by the run length.', for example aabbbc becomes a2b3c1. Run-length encode "aabbbc". Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.

A phrase is an ASCII palindrome when, after removing every character that is not a letter or digit and lowercasing, it reads the same forwards and backwards. Is "No lemon, no melon" an ASCII palindrome? Answer true or false. Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.
Kebab case lowercases everything and joins words with single hyphens. What is the kebab-case of "Loop Bench Results"? Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.

To convert snake_case to camelCase, split on underscores; the first segment stays lowercase; every later segment gets its first letter uppercased and the rest lowercased. Convert "snake_to_camel" to camelCase. Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.

ASCII title case collapses space runs to single spaces, trims, then uppercases the first letter of every word and lowercases all other letters. Convert "THE quick BROWN fox" to title case. Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.
An acronym takes the first letter of every word and uppercases it, with no spaces. What is the acronym of "light emission diode"? Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.
Counting vowels counts the characters a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitively; y is NOT a vowel. How many vowels are in "The quick brown fox"? Answer with only the result on the first line, nothing else.
